---
title: "exploreDE: Display Label Feature for Proteomics"
date: "2026-03-27"
format: html
---

## Goal

Allow users to choose what ID column proteomics features are **displayed** by on plots. Currently, all labels use `feature_id` (Uniprot-based). Users should be able to see gene symbols (and for peptide/phospho data, protein IDs) alongside or instead of the raw feature ID.

## Display Format

Labels follow the pattern: `feature_id (selected_label)`.

- Protein-level: `Q07820 (MCL1)`
- Peptide-level: `A0A024RBG1;Q9NZJ9_EVYEEAGVK (MCL1)`
- Phospho: `A0A2R8Y4L2_A0A2R8... (MCL1)`

**Truncation rule:** when `feature_id` exceeds 15 characters, truncate to `first_15_chars... (LABEL)`. This keeps heatmap rows and boxplot facet strips readable.

When `gene_name` is `NA` for a given feature, show the bare `feature_id` with no brackets.

## Radio Button Options (Dynamic Per Data Type)

### Protein-level data (`feature_id == protein_Id`)

| Option | Label example |
|--------|---------------|
| Protein ID (default) | `Q07820` |
| Gene Symbol | `Q07820 (MCL1)` |

### Peptide / phospho data (`feature_id != protein_Id`)

| Option | Label example |
|--------|---------------|
| Feature ID (default) | `A0A024RBG1;Q9NZJ9_EVYEEAGVK` |
| Protein ID | `A0A024RBG1;Q9NZJ9_EVYEEAGVK (A0A024RBG1;Q9NZJ9)` |
| Gene Symbol | `A0A024RBG1;Q9NZ... (MCL1)` |

The radio sits **above the feature selectize dropdown** on each tab. Changing it:

1. Updates the selectize dropdown choices to match the selected ID space
2. Clears current selectize/text inputs (bucket contents stay)
3. Updates plot labels across all tabs

## Behaviour When User Selects Gene Symbol

- Selectize shows gene symbols as choices
- Selecting a gene symbol adds **all** matching feature_ids to the bucket (1:N expansion via `gene_lookup`)
- Features with `NA` gene_name are not selectable in this mode
- The bucket internally still stores `feature_id` values (the unique key for count matrix lookups)

## Current Bug: `gene_lookup` Not Available in App

The `gene_lookup` infrastructure exists in `R/helperFunctions.R` (package version of `convert_proteomics_se`), but the app runs its own local copy in `inst/app/server-initInputData.R` which **diverged** and never got the `gene_lookup` code. Specifically:

- `helperFunctions.R` lines 297-306: builds `gene_lookup` and returns it
- `server-initInputData.R` lines 330-342: no `gene_lookup`, not returned

This means `inputDataReactive()$gene_lookup` is always `NULL`, the existing "Search by" radio buttons (`fb_search_mode_*` in `server-featureBucket.R:196-220`) silently fail to render, and the whole gene-symbol search pathway is dead code in the live app.

**Fix first:** sync `server-initInputData.R` with the package version before building the display label feature.

## Architecture

### New reactive: `display_lookup`

Built at init time from seqAnnoList, updated when the radio changes:

```r
# feature_id -> display_label
# e.g. for gene_name mode:
display_lookup <- setNames(seqAnnoList[[1]]$gene_name, seqAnnoList[[1]]$feature_id)
```

### New helper: `make_display_label(feature_ids, lookup, max_chars = 15)`

```r
make_display_label <- function(feature_ids, lookup = NULL, max_chars = 15) {
  if (is.null(lookup)) return(feature_ids)
  labels <- lookup[feature_ids]
  # Where lookup matches feature_id or is NA, return bare feature_id
  same_or_na <- is.na(labels) | labels == feature_ids
  out <- ifelse(
    same_or_na,
    feature_ids,
    ifelse(
      nchar(feature_ids) > max_chars,
      paste0(substr(feature_ids, 1, max_chars), "... (", labels, ")"),
      paste0(feature_ids, " (", labels, ")")
    )
  )
  out
}
```

### Merging search + display radios

The existing per-tab `fb_search_by_*` radios get replaced by a single `display_by` concept. One radio per tab (synced via observer) or one global radio. Controls both:

- What the selectize shows as choices
- What labels appear on plots

## Edge Cases

- **NA gene_name**: feature not selectable in gene-symbol mode; bare feature_id shown on plots
- **Multiple feature_ids per gene**: all get added to bucket when gene selected; each gets its own facet/row with its own feature_id in the label
- **Switching radio clears inputs**: selectize and text area empty, bucket contents preserved
- **Downloads (xlsx)**: should include both `feature_id` and the display column so data is traceable

## Open Questions

1. Should the radio be truly global (one widget, all tabs follow) or per-tab but synced?
2. For the DEG table, should the display label be a filterable column or replace feature_id?
3. Protein_Id column is currently dropped for protein-level data when it equals feature_id -- need to preserve it (or gene_name) for the lookup to work
